Class Gmail

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.agi.tool.ToolContext
uno.anahata.asi.agi.tool.AnahataToolkit
uno.anahata.asi.yam.tools.gmail.Gmail
All Implemented Interfaces:
ContextProvider, PropertyChangeSource, Rebindable
public class Gmail extends AnahataToolkit
Pure Java Gmail API toolkit providing email search, RFC 822 MIME inspection, chronological thread Markdown export, and batch raw EML and attachment harvesting.

Implements direct HTTP integration with the official Google Gmail REST API v1 using standard HttpClient without external Google client libraries. Integrates with GmailAuthHelper for local loopback OAuth2 authorization and automated token refresh.

Author:
anahata

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      public void initialize()
      Performs initial setup for a newly created toolkit instance.

      This method is called exactly once by the ToolManager after the toolkit has been instantiated and registered. It provides a clean hook for toolkits to perform one-time initialization logic that requires the tool environment to be fully configured, such as scanning for project instructions or registering default resources.

      Initializes the Gmail toolkit.

      Overrides:
      initialize in class AnahataToolkit

    • populateMessage

      public void populateMessage(RagMessage ragMessage) throws Exception
      Populates the given RagMessage with dynamic, just-in-time context parts. These parts are appended to the end of the user's prompt (RAG).

      Injects live Gmail authentication status, authorized account address, total message and thread metrics, and last search telemetry into the RAG message.

      Parameters:
      ragMessage - The message to be augmented with context.
      Throws:
      Exception - if an error occurs during context generation.

    • loginWithCredentialsFile

      public String loginWithCredentialsFile(String credentialsJsonPath) throws Exception
      Authorizes the Gmail session using official Google Client Secrets JSON or stored credentials.

      If a path is provided, parses client_id and client_secret from the file and initiates the browser OAuth2 consent flow. If no path is provided, attempts to load credentials from ~/.anahata/asi/gmail/credentials.json.

      Parameters:
      credentialsJsonPath - The optional path to the Google Cloud OAuth 2.0 client_secret.json file.
      Returns:
      Confirmation message indicating successful authorization.
      Throws:
      Exception - If file reading, browser launch, or authorization fails.

    • downloadAttachment

      public String downloadAttachment(String messageId, String attachmentId, String destinationPath) throws Exception
      Downloads an individual email attachment to disk on demand.

      Allows surgical, on-the-fly extraction of a specific attachment while inspecting an email without having to perform a full bulk export.

      Parameters:
      messageId - The unique Gmail message ID containing the attachment.
      attachmentId - The attachment ID obtained via getEmailDetails(String).
      destinationPath - The destination file path on the local filesystem.
      Returns:
      Confirmation message with the saved file path and size.
      Throws:
      Exception - If downloading, decoding, or file creation fails.

    • bulkExportQuery

      public String bulkExportQuery(String query, String targetDirectory, Boolean downloadAttachments) throws Exception
      Executes a search query, downloads all matching emails as .eml and .md, optionally downloads attachments, and generates an INDEX.md catalog.
      Parameters:
      query - Standard Gmail search query (e.g. after:2024/01/01 to:me).
      targetDirectory - The destination directory folder path for harvested files.
      downloadAttachments - Whether to download binary file attachments into an 'attachments' subfolder.
      Returns:
      Comprehensive summary report of harvested artifacts.
      Throws:
      Exception - If network errors, API failures, or disk write issues occur.
